verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair question for an open-source local inference engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a license, a paid tier, a subscription, or terms for commercial or enterprise use. The items cover only technical features: SSD offload, prerouter, LoRA adapters, serving, and platform apps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
